verses.raw: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
verses.text: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

verses.raw: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
verses.text: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

verses.raw: And it became as though reaped.
verses.text: And it became as though reaped.

verses.raw: And they called one another at morning,
verses.text: And they called one another at morning,

verses.raw: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
verses.text: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

verses.raw: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
verses.text: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

verses.raw: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
verses.text: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

verses.raw: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.<sup foot_note=257127>1</sup>
verses.text: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

verses.raw: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
verses.text: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

verses.raw: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"<sup foot_note=257129>1</sup>
verses.text: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"

verses.raw: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.text: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

verses.raw: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
verses.text: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

verses.raw: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
verses.text: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

verses.raw: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."<sup foot_note=257131>1</sup>
verses.text: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."

verses.raw: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
verses.text: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
